name: profile-capture-isolation
goal: Independent runtime observation producers and successive flushes retain distinct immutable capture chunks with no overwritten evidence.

evidence: The one-pass API introduced at5790bba3 keys capture paths by unit, callable, workload and completion only. Independent producers or repeated flushes share that key and can overwrite earlier observation bytes. Reproduce before connecting standard workers.

The standard profiler suite covers separate workloads and clearing one flush, but not multiple producers or successive chunks for the same workload. Extend that suite with distinct producer instances and repeated flushes, asserting unique paths and intact per-chunk samples.

Sealed redef47b89822ea89ad633bacfbe991f4f0858f476e0e6b673a7cad1f942007f33d at6e13136c reproduces both same-workload batch overwrites and independent/flush observation overwrites. Six other profiling cases pass.

Separate comparable workload identity from immutable capture identity. Preserve the workload group hash and add a unique chunk suffix for both batch and one-pass captures; keep values, sampling and performance limits unchanged. Enforce multiple producers and repeated chunks in the standard suite before runner integration.

Both capture paths retain stable workload grouping and add a unique chunk identifier after sampling. All23 focused tests, types and source audit pass. The local skill now requires producer/chunk isolation coverage before worker profiling and validates successfully.
